semantic_reason: The PR fixes a reported defect: calculations named with a trailing '?' failed when calling the bang variant because the '!' was appended to the name producing 'is_true?!' while the generated bang function was named 'is_true?'. The fix introduces resolve_calc_method_names to map safe/bang names correctly, resolving FunctionClauseError described in issue #857.
